customManagers.description: Track each mariadb CI matrix leg as its own dependency (keyed by the leg's mediawiki_version), since plain docker-image detection in ci.yml would otherwise treat both legs as one 'mariadb' package and let allowedVersions leak across legs.

Track each SemanticMediaWiki CI matrix leg as its own dependency (keyed by the leg's mediawiki_version), since smw_version flows into build/Dockerfile's composer-require.sh call via a plain YAML string that Renovate's built-in managers do not detect at all.

packageRules.description: MW 1.39 / PHP 8.1 CI leg caps this at 48.0.0 — v50+ requires PHP >=8.2.0 (v49.0.0 also requires PHP >=8.2.0 despite absent Packagist metadata). See registry.yml verified_max_for.
MW 1.39 / PHP 8.1 CI leg caps this at 1.1.3 — v2.0.0+ requires PHP >=8.2. See registry.yml verified_max_for.

Disable the built-in github-actions/docker detection of database_image: "mariadb:..." in ci.yml — the customManagers regex above tracks each matrix leg separately instead, so this would otherwise duplicate/conflict with mariadb-mw1.43 and mariadb-mw1.46.
MW 1.43 and MW 1.46 CI legs both pin the mariadb:12.x line (aligned 2026-08-22) — keep updates within 12.x, do not jump to 13.x without adding/testing a new CI leg first.

MW 1.39 CI leg is pinned to the SMW 5.x line — SMW 6.0.0 already requires MediaWiki >= 1.43 (checked via SemanticMediaWiki's own extension.json at tag 6.0.0, 2026-09-20), so this leg cannot take it. Track 5.x minor/patch updates only.
MW 1.43 and MW 1.46 CI legs are pinned to the SMW 7.x line. Track 7.x minor/patch updates (e.g. 7.2.0 -> 7.3.0) automatically; re-verify MediaWiki compatibility before allowing a jump to 8.x.

package.json pins brace-expansion to ^5.0.7 via an override scoped to minimatch@^10 (8d0d7d39) to close Dependabot alert #36 (exponential-time brace-expansion DoS below 5.0.7). minimatch@10's own peer range still points at brace-expansion@^1.x, so Renovate proposes reverting the override to v1 — do not let that land; bump the override version manually instead if a newer secure release supersedes 5.0.7. (No matchCurrentVersion here: Renovate tracks the hoisted top-level node_modules/brace-expansion, which resolves to eslint's own unrelated 1.x branch, not the override-protected nested 5.0.x copies under nyc/minimatch@10 — a version-scoped match on ^5.0.7 never fires and let PR #205 slip through on 2026-09-20.)

eslint-config-wikimedia@0.32.5 (our current version) declares peerDependencies.eslint '^8.57.0' — no published eslint-config-wikimedia release yet supports eslint 9/10 (checked npm view eslint-config-wikimedia versions, 2026-08-25). A bot-proposed eslint@9/10 bump breaks lockfile resolution (renovate/artifacts failure on PR #199) and, if forced through, would silently stop loading our .eslintrc.json since eslint 9+ defaults to flat config. Remove this ceiling once eslint-config-wikimedia publishes a release whose peerDependencies allow the newer eslint major, and upgrade both together in the same PR.

All three CI legs' base images (gesinn/mediawiki-ci:1.39-php8.1, 1.43-php8.3, 1.46-php8.4) run Node.js v20.19.2 (checked via `docker run --rm <image> node --version`, 2026-08-25). jsdom 30.x requires engines.node '^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0' (jsdom 29.x only required '^20.19.0 || ...') — confirmed via `make ci` (PR #202): jsdom 30's undici dependency crashes with `TypeError: webidl.util.markAsUncloneable is not a function` on Node 20, since that API doesn't exist until later Node majors. Remove this ceiling once the CI base images are upgraded to a Node.js version jsdom 30+ supports.
